in_marathi.name: Palakshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Palakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Palakshi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Palaka', which means 'prosperity'. The name is often given to girls to bless them with wealth, abundance, and good fortune in life. In Hindu mythology, Palakshi is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity.
